title: SoK: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Emulation-Based Dynamic Analysis Research for ARM Cortex-M Firmware (Extended Version)

Result: Not verified — arXiv returned 403, so no findings or numbers are available. Why it matters: Shows which firmware-analysis tools actually work, useful for reverse engineers and fuzzers. Glossary: Cortex-M (ARM microcontroller family); dynamic analysis (running code to observe behavior); emulation (software imitating hardware); SoK (survey paper).

title: Agent-Warden: eBPF-Based Kernel-Native Process-File Provenance Tracking for LLM Agents
blurb: Problem: LLM agents run commands and touch files, making it hard to trace what actually caused a change. Approach: Per the title, uses eBPF to track process-to-file provenance inside the Linux kernel for agents. Result: Not verified — arXiv returned 403, so no measurements are available. Why it matters: Kernel-level tracking gives audit evidence agents can't easily bypass. Glossary: eBPF (sandboxed kernel programs); provenance (record of what touched what); kernel-native (runs inside the OS kernel).
